# pve_sdn_vnet (Data Source)

Reads a single SDN vnet object (`GET /cluster/sdn/vnets/{vnet}`). Set `node` to additionally read the per-node MAC VRF routes (`GET /nodes/{node}/sdn/vnets/{vnet}/mac-vrf`, EVPN zones).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read an SDN vnet; set `node` to also fetch the per-node MAC VRF routes.

data "pve_sdn_vnet" "vnet1" {
  vnet = "vnet1"
  node = "pve1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vnet` (String) The SDN vnet object identifier to read.

### Optional

- `node` (String) Cluster node name. When set, the `mac_vrf` attribute carries the vnet's per-node MAC VRF routes.

### Read-Only

- `alias` (String) Alias name of the vnet.
- `digest` (String) Digest of the vnet section.
- `isolate_ports` (Boolean) Whether the isolated property is set for all interfaces on the bridge of this vnet.
- `mac_vrf` (Attributes List) Routes from the MAC VRF that the chosen node self-originates or has learned via BGP (EVPN zones); empty unless `node` is set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mac_vrf))
- `state` (String) State of the SDN configuration object; one of `new`, `changed`, or `deleted` when the configuration has not been applied yet.
- `tag` (Number) VLAN tag (for VLAN or QinQ zones) or VXLAN VNI (for VXLAN or EVPN zones).
- `vlanaware` (Boolean) Whether VLANs pass through this vnet.
- `zone` (String) Name of the zone this vnet belongs to.

<a id="nestedatt--mac_vrf"></a>
### Nested Schema for `mac_vrf`

Read-Only:

- `ip` (String) IP address of the MAC VRF entry.
- `mac` (String) MAC address of the MAC VRF entry.
- `nexthop` (String) IP address of the nexthop.
